import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem aime_1983_p1 (x y z w : ℕ) (ht : 1 < x ∧ 1 < y ∧ 1 < z) (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (h0 : Real.log w / Real.log x = 24) (h1 : Real.log w / Real.log y = 40)
    (h2 : Real.log w / Real.log (x * y * z) = 12) : Real.log w / Real.log z = 60 := by
  have hx : (x : ℝ) > 1 := by
    norm_cast
    <;> linarith [ht.1]

  have hy : (y : ℝ) > 1 := by
    norm_cast
    <;> linarith [ht.2.1]

  have hz : (z : ℝ) > 1 := by
    norm_cast
    <;> linarith [ht.2.2]

  have h_log_x : Real.log (x : ℝ) > 0 := by
    -- Prove that the logarithm of x is positive because x > 1.
    have h : Real.log (x : ℝ) > 0 := Real.log_pos hx
    exact h

  have h_log_y : Real.log (y : ℝ) > 0 := by
    -- Prove that the logarithm of y is positive because y > 1.
    have h : Real.log (y : ℝ) > 0 := Real.log_pos hy
    exact h

  have h_log_z : Real.log (z : ℝ) > 0 := by
    -- Prove that the logarithm of z is positive because z > 1.
    have h : Real.log (z : ℝ) > 0 := Real.log_pos hz
    exact h

  have h_log_xy : Real.log (x * y : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) := by
    -- Prove that the logarithm of the product is the sum of the logarithms.
    have h : Real.log (x * y : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    exact h

  have h_log_xyz : Real.log (x * y * z : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by
    -- Prove that the logarithm of the product is the sum of the logarithms.
    have h : Real.log (x * y * z : ℝ) = Real.log (x * y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by
      have h₁ : Real.log (x * y * z : ℝ) = Real.log ((x * y : ℝ) * (z : ℝ)) := by ring_nf
      rw [h₁]
      have h₂ : Real.log ((x * y : ℝ) * (z : ℝ)) = Real.log (x * y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by
        rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      rw [h₂]
      <;> simp [h_log_xy]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h, h_log_xy]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> linarith

  have h3 : Real.log w = 24 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
    have h3₁ : Real.log w / Real.log (x : ℝ) = 24 := by simpa using h0
    have h3₂ : Real.log w = 24 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
      have h3₃ : Real.log (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith

      <;> nlinarith
    exact h3₂

    have h4₂ : Real.log w = 40 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := by
      have h4₃ : Real.log (y : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp at h4₁
      <;> nlinarith
    exact h4₂

  have h5 : 3 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = 5 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := by

    have h5₂ : Real.log w = 40 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := h4
    have h5₃ : 24 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = 40 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h5₄ : 3 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = 5 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := by

    rw [h6₁₀] at h6₂
    linarith

  have h7 : Real.log (x : ℝ) = Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by
    have h7₁ : Real.log w = 12 * (Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ)) := h6
    have h7₂ : Real.log w = 24 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := h3
    have h7₃ : 24 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = 12 * (Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ)) := by linarith
    have h7₄ : 2 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h7₅ : Real.log (x : ℝ) = Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact h7₅

  have h8 : Real.log (z : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ)/5 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
    have h8₁ : 3 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = 5 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := h5
    have h8₂ : Real.log (x : ℝ) = Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := h7
    have h8₃ : Real.log (y : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ)/5 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
      have h8₄ : 3 * Real.log (x : ℝ) = 5 * Real.log (y : ℝ) := h5
      have h8₅ : Real.log (y : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ)/5 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (5 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
        linarith
      exact h8₅
    have h8₄ : Real.log (x : ℝ) = Real.log (y : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := h7
    have h8₅ : Real.log (x : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ)/5 * Real.log (x : ℝ) + Real.log (z : ℝ) := by
      rw [h8₃] at h8₄
      linarith
    have h8₆ : Real.log (z : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ)/5 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    exact h8₆

  have h9 : Real.log w / Real.log (z : ℝ) = 60 := by
    have h9₁ : Real.log w = 24 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := h3
    have h9₂ : Real.log (z : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ)/5 * Real.log (x : ℝ) := h8
    have h9₃ : Real.log w / Real.log (z : ℝ) = 60 := by
      rw [h9₁, h9₂]
      have h9₄ : Real.log (x : ℝ) > 0 := h_log_x
      field_simp [h9₄.ne']
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h9₄.ne']
      <;> nlinarith
    exact h9₃

  exact h9

import Mathlib
import Aesop

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem aime_1991_p9 (x : ℝ) (m : ℚ) (h₀ : 1 / Real.cos x + Real.tan x = 22 / 7)

  have h_cos_ne_zero : Real.cos x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₂ : Real.cos x = 0 := by simpa using h
    have h₃ : Real.tan x = 0 := by
      rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      rw [h₂]
      simp
    have h₄ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.cos x + Real.tan x = 0 := by
      rw [h₂, h₃]
      <;> norm_num
    linarith
  
  have h_sin_ne_zero : Real.sin x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₂ : Real.sin x = 0 := by simpa using h
    have h₃ : Real.tan x = 0 := by
      rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      rw [h₂]
      <;> simp
      <;> field_simp [h_cos_ne_zero]
      <;> ring
    have h₄ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sin x + 1 / Real.tan x = 0 := by
      rw [h₂, h₃]
      <;> norm_num
    have h₅ : (m : ℝ) = 0 := by
      norm_cast at h₁ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [div_eq_mul_inv]
      <;> ring_nf at *
      <;> norm_num at *
      <;> linarith
    have h₆ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.cos x + Real.tan x = 22 / 7 := by simpa using h₀
    have h₇ : Real.cos x = 7 / 22 := by
      have h₇₁ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.cos x + Real.tan x = 22 / 7 := by simpa using h₀
      have h₇₂ : Real.tan x = 0 := by simpa using h₃
      rw [h₇₂] at h₇₁
      have h₇₃ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.cos x = 22 / 7 := by linarith
      have h₇₄ : Real.cos x ≠ 0 := by simpa using h_cos_ne_zero
      field_simp at h₇₃ ⊢
      <;> nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x, Real.sin_le_one x, Real.cos_le_one x, sq_nonneg (Real.sin x + Real.cos x), sq_nonneg (Real.sin x - Real.cos x)]

      rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq]
    have h₉ : Real.sin x ^ 2 + (7 / 22 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [h₇] at h₈
      <;> ring_nf at h₈ ⊢
      <;> nlinarith
    have h₁₀ : Real.sin x = 0 := by simpa using h₂

    <;> linarith
  
  have h_false : False := by

        have h₉ : Real.cos x ≠ 0 := h_cos_ne_zero
        field_simp [h₉] at h₇

      exact h₈
    have h₃ : (m : ℝ) * Real.sin x = 1 + Real.cos x := by
      have h₄ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sin x + 1 / Real.tan x = (m : ℝ) := by
        norm_cast at h₁ ⊢
        <;> simp_all [div_eq_mul_inv]
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
      have h₅ : Real.tan x = Real.sin x / Real.cos x := by
        rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
      rw [h₅] at h₄

        simpa using h₄
      have h₇ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sin x + 1 / (Real.sin x / Real.cos x) = (1 : ℝ) / Real.sin x + Real.cos x / Real.sin x := by
        field_simp [h_sin_ne_zero, h_cos_ne_zero]

          <;> ring

          <;> ring_nf

          <;> ring

          have h₁₃ : Real.cos x = (7 + 7 * Real.sin x) / 22 := by

          rw [h₁₀]
